headline.text: L1 Sollich 3 had multiple equipment failures totaling *~5 hours* downtime before finishing the week—metal detector belt issue left unresolved into end-of-week clean.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 fought through a rough first shift—E-stop on the metal detector, enrober cold from another E-stop, bag tapper failures, and a snapped pressure cable after an EE sweeping incident. All cleared by mid-afternoon, but late 2nd shift the metal detector belt stopped again with no resolution before the weekend clean started. Sollich 2 ran almond cluster steadily with 26 hours of almond inventory left heading into Monday.
per_plant_summary.L2: Flow wrap material for item 40910 is short—arriving Monday 7/27 per the supplier.
per_plant_summary.L3: Molding Line 1 battled seal quality on the Cavanna all day (pinholes on water test) and a wave of bad flow wrap rolls with missing adhesive on 2nd shift. Biggest hit was the cooler compressor faulting out at 18:15, keeping the line down until 21:15 when it self-recovered. Product in the cooler went to rework. Overnight crew discovered a broken hopper heater tube during wash—maintenance unable to extract the fitting.

notes.text: Katya flagged that most of today's S3 issues could have been avoided if start-up checklists were followed—enforcement plan in progress.
Canadian Smore Clusters completed 60 pallets and ready to ship to SV.
William Lopez will show the team on Monday how to clean/water the roof compressor unit during hot weather to prevent high-pressure trips.

resolved.title: Metal detector E-stop and wrong recipe loaded
resolved.summary: E-stop pressed at line start triggered MD belt fault; troubleshooting revealed the wrong recipe was uploaded, which prevented normal operation.
resolved.resolution: Correct recipe uploaded at 08:30, QA passed cards, MD running normally by 08:36 per Jason Jensen.

resolved.title: Enrober E-stop caused 6-minute cold soak and partial reheat
resolved.summary: Phantom E-stop in the line dropped enrober temp; 3rd shift also reported return pump faulting overnight from high pressure.
resolved.resolution: Partial reheat completed, two good tempers achieved, line resumed operations at 09:05 per S3 Enrober.

resolved.title: Multiple MM mechanical issues requiring re-zero
resolved.summary: Accumulation of MM problems forced line pause to pass product, re-zero all scales and checkweighers, and complete mechanical repairs.
resolved.resolution: Line back up and running at 13:15 per Katya Farnsworth.

resolved.title: Enrober return pump pressure cable snapped
resolved.summary: EE sweeping accidentally caught broom between pressure cable and chute, snapping the cable; without the sensor the return pump wouldn't run, forcing reheat.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance repaired sensor, gave go-ahead to start tempering at 15:56 per William Beattie.

resolved.title: MM4 and MM5 bag tappers not functioning
resolved.summary: Bag tappers failed, product not dropping into pouches, creating dirty seal rejects; blue gear controlling suction cups also damaged.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance rotated damaged gear, line resumed at 10:03 per S3 Enrober.

resolved.title: MM4 silver line on pouches
resolved.summary: Silver line appearing on Matrix 4 bags during sealing; initially stopped using MM4, then monitored as maintenance adjusted.
resolved.resolution: Improved to 1 in 10 at ~2.5mm by 18:21 after Caleb York's heat sealer alignment and settings adjustments.

resolved.title: MM3 backing plates installed incorrectly
resolved.summary: Visual inspection found plates and backing plates on MM3 not installed correctly; removed and reinstalled during shift startup.
resolved.resolution: Removed and installed correctly during visual inspection at 07:54 per S3 Pack.

resolved.title: Brookie cereal found in wrong aisles
resolved.summary: Brookie cereal discovered in aisles C21, C22, C23 during 5S sweep; material removed to prevent cross-contamination.
resolved.resolution: Removed from area at 08:12 per S3 Pack.

resolved.title: Cavanna seal pinholes on water test
resolved.summary: Bars failing water pressure test with 2–4 out of 5 showing pinhole leaks; Nathan escalated, maintenance adjusted jaws and seal pressure throughout the day.
resolved.resolution: Preston cleared line to continue running at 13:46—pinholes minor and normal occurrence, will troubleshoot further on Monday.

resolved.title: Bad flow wrap rolls with missing adhesive
resolved.summary: Bars not sealing or cutting; found 9+ rolls with gaps in glue or insufficient adhesive strength across multiple pallets.
resolved.resolution: Line restarted at 18:13 after finding better rolls and adjusting Cavanna roller centering—2 of 10 pieces bad seal, rest acceptable.

resolved.title: Cooler compressor high-pressure fault
resolved.summary: Cooler climbed to 74°F; roof compressor tripped on high pressure and would not reset, keeping line down from 18:15 to 21:15.
resolved.resolution: Compressor self-recovered at 21:15 after ambient temp drop; cooler dropped to 54° and product moved to rework per Tyson Fausett.

resolved.title: High chocolate temper at line start
resolved.summary: Temper reading too high, stopped sending chocolate to hopper to bring temperature down into range.
resolved.resolution: Temper dropped to 0.8, resumed sending chocolate to hopper at 08:02 per Grey Boscan.

resolved.title: 8 cooler buckets not installed correctly
resolved.summary: Maintenance PM inspection found 8 buckets in the cooler improperly positioned during routine check.
resolved.resolution: Corrected during PM per Tyson Fausett at 16:07.

needs_attention.title: Metal detector belt stopped unexpectedly
needs_attention.summary: MD belt stopped late 2nd shift; EEs began removing accumulated product to attempt restart but no resolution posted before line went into end-of-week clean.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 23:05, product being cleared; no restart confirmed before EOW clean began at 02:54.

needs_attention.title: Bat entered the facility
needs_attention.summary: Bat found in production area during 3rd shift; safety and maintenance notified to remove and assess exposed product per FSQA procedures.
needs_attention.status: Charity Young acknowledged at 04:28, will determine who to contact for removal; no update on capture or product assessment.

needs_attention.title: Left hopper heater tube broken during wash
needs_attention.summary: Heater tube fitting broke while washing; maintenance cannot extract broken piece from the threads and no replacement fitting available.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance tried penetrating oil, heat, and extractor as of 05:54 with no success; thread may be damaged, no thread insert on-site per Jose Vasquez.
